payload.entry: core repair complete on linked sase-core master dd56b94a (PR #331 still only the 0.42.0 release chore 0b23a739; no concurrent openat fix). Both O_CREAT openat calls now pass openat_creat_mode(PROTECTED_FILE_MODE) -> libc::c_uint (lossless From; targeted clippy::useless_conversion for Linux identity). mkdirat/fchmod keep native mode_t. Comment no longer claims native mode_t is valid for every syscall. Linux pass is not macOS CI; watch phase must confirm job 117510033363-class macOS compile. Did not pin sase, wait on this commit, or edit release metadata.
